During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a '''Twi'lek thug''' worked for the [[Switch's organization|criminal organization]] of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Switch]], as Switch's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]]. The organization established a base of operations in [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] on [[Sel Zonn Station]], an [[XQ2 Platform]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] paid monthly bribes to the [[Unidentified Sel Zonn Station manager|station manager]], to keep the location of Switch's headquarters secret.
